title: Fourier coefficient of a convolution
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f,g$ be real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional binary cube, and let $S$ be a subset of its coordinates. The Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the convolution of $f$ and $g$ equals the product of their Fourier coefficients at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f,g$ are real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional binary cube
$S$ is a finite set of coordinates
